incident.name: Log4Shell (Log4j)
incident.description: Critical RCE in Apache Log4j (CVE-2021-44228). CVSS 10.0. Affected billions of devices. Exploited within hours of disclosure.
incident.root_cause: Insecure JNDI lookup in ubiquitous logging library
incident.lessons: Dependency management and SBOMs are essential. Patch velocity matters.

relatedIncidents.name: Heartbleed (CVE-2014-0160)
relatedIncidents.description: Critical OpenSSL vulnerability allowed reading server memory, exposing private keys and passwords. Affected ~17% of internet.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: Buffer over-read bug in OpenSSL TLS heartbeat extension
relatedIncidents.lessons: Open source security auditing and rapid patch deployment are critical.

relatedIncidents.name: Snowflake Customer Breaches
relatedIncidents.description: Attackers used credentials stolen by infostealer malware to access 165+ Snowflake customer accounts with no MFA enabled.
relatedIncidents.root_cause: No MFA enforcement on cloud data platform, infostealer malware on employee devices
relatedIncidents.lessons: Cloud platforms must enforce MFA. Infostealer malware is a primary credential theft vector.
